name: Paranormal Activity's Gambit
author: Minty
summary: Selling a gambit gives Ghost's Gambit. 6/66 chance of giving Demon's Gambit instead.
description: Adds a rare gambit that gives Ghost’s Gambit when you sell another gambit, with a 6/66 chance to give Demon’s Gambit instead. Selling Ghost’s Gambit does not trigger the effect, and a gambit slot must be available.
